translations.1: Then God spoke to Moses in the wilderness of Moab, by the Jordan of Jericho, speaking.
translations.2: Command the sons of Israel that they give to the Levites, from the inheritance of their possession, towns to dwell in, and open spaces for them round about them.
translations.3: And the towns shall be a dwelling for them, and their open spaces shall be for their beasts and their flocks and the rest of their animals.
translations.4: And the open spaces of the towns which you give to the Levites shall extend from outside the wall of the town one thousand cubits all around.
translations.5: Then measure from outside the town: toward the east two thousand cubits, and toward the south two thousand cubits, and toward the west two thousand cubits, and toward the north two thousand cubits — with the town in the midst of them. That shall be for you the measure of the open spaces of the towns.
translations.6: And the towns which you give to the Levites — among them shall be the six towns of refuge which you set apart, so that the killer may flee to them; and add to them forty-two towns.
translations.7: So all the towns which you give shall be forty-eight towns, with their open spaces.
translations.8: And the towns which you give from the possession of the sons of Israel — from him who took much, give more; and from him who took little, give less; each tribe shall give according to the measure of its inheritance.
translations.9: Then God spoke to Moses, speaking.
translations.10: Command the sons of Israel, and say to them: When you have crossed the Jordan into the land of Canaan,
translations.11: then designate for yourselves towns of refuge, so that any killer who has slain a person unintentionally may flee to them.
translations.12: And those towns shall be a protection from the blood-avenger; and he shall not be killed until he has stood before the assembly, that they may judge him in this matter.
translations.13: And the towns which you set apart — six towns of refuge shall they be for you.
translations.14: Three of them shall be across the Jordan, and three of them shall be in the land of Canaan — they shall be towns of refuge.
translations.15: For the sons of Israel and for the stranger and for the guest who has entered among them — every one who has slain a person unintentionally may flee to them.
translations.16: But if he struck him with an iron implement and killed him, he is a killer who deserves to be put to death.
translations.17: Or if he struck him with a stone held in the hand, of a size sufficient to cause death, and killed him, he is a killer who deserves to be put to death.
translations.18: Or if he struck him with a wooden implement held in the hand, of a size sufficient to cause death, and killed him, he is a killer who deserves to be put to death.
translations.19: The blood-avenger — he shall put him to death when he encounters him, rightfully.
translations.20: And if he shoved him out of hatred, or hurled something at him deliberately, and killed him,
translations.21: or struck him with his hand out of enmity and killed him — then the striker shall surely be put to death, for he is a killer; the blood-avenger shall put him to death when he encounters him, rightfully.
translations.22: But if he pushed him suddenly without hatred, or threw any implement at him without intent,
translations.23: or dropped upon him any stone — without intent — and he died, and he was not his enemy and was not seeking his harm,
translations.24: then the assembly shall judge between the killer and the blood-avenger, according to these ordinances.
translations.25: And the assembly shall deliver this killer from the hand of the blood-avenger, and shall return him to the town of refuge to which he fled; and he shall remain there until the death of the great imām who was anointed with the oil of holiness.
translations.26: But if he goes out beyond the boundary of the town of refuge to which he fled,
translations.27: and the blood-avenger finds him outside the boundary of the town of refuge and kills him — there is no vengeance for him.
translations.28: Rather, he must stay in the town of refuge until the death of the great imām; and after his death he may return to the land of his possession.
translations.29: And these shall be ordinances for you throughout the passing of your generations, in all your dwellings.
translations.30: Every one who has slain a person intentionally — by the word of two witnesses put him to death; but a single witness shall not testify against him so that he be put to death.
translations.31: And you shall not accept blood-money as ransom for the life of a killer who is liable to be put to death — he shall surely be put to death.
translations.32: Nor shall you accept from him blood-money to allow him to flee to one of the towns of refuge, so that he may return and dwell in the land after the death of the imām.
translations.33: And you shall not defile the land in which you are; for blood defiles it, and atonement cannot be made for you concerning the blood that was shed in it, except by the blood of him who shed it.
translations.34: And you shall not make impure the land in which you are dwelling, in which My light dwells — for I am God, My light dwelling in the midst of the sons of Israel.
